findings.message: The autocomplete composer declares aria-autocomplete and aria-controls but no combobox role or aria-expanded, so assistive tech is never told whether the slash or mention popup is open. This hunk replaced aria-expanded with aria-controls; the correct ARIA 1.2 pattern needs both the role and the expanded state alongside the controls reference. Applied directly to the working tree and verified: buil
